P: Serve dessert when the pottery wheel scene starts.
S: Oda Mae's tarot card cheddar crackers
the candlelit parlour of Oda Mae Brown, fake psychic

Crisp sharp cheddar and rosemary crackers cut into tarot-card rectangles, with fig jam and a wedge of blue cheese. Pulse 150g plain flour, 100g cold butter, 150g grated sharp cheddar, 1 tsp chopped rosemary and a pinch of cayenne until it clumps, adding 1 tbsp cold water. Chill 30 minutes, roll 3mm thick and cut into 5 x 8cm rectangles. Prick and bake at 180C for 14 minutes until golden. Serve with 120g fig jam and 150g blue cheese.
Fried cornmeal fritters with spring onion, honey butter on the side
Cornmeal batter with spring onion and a little sugar, dropped in spoonfuls into oil at 180C until golden, honey butter for dipping.
Garlic rubbed grilled baguette, diced tomato, basil and olive oil
Grill baguette slices, rub with a cut garlic clove, top with diced ripe tomato dressed with basil, salt and good olive oil.
M: Rigatoni with Italian sausage, fennel, white wine and cream
Brown crumbled Italian sausage with sliced fennel and garlic, deglaze with white wine, splash of cream, toss with rigatoni and parmesan.
her sisters crowded round the table
Beef chuck browned and braised at 160C for 3 hours with onion, carrot, garlic and stock, potatoes for the last hour, gravy from the juices.
W: Cinnamon apples folded into hand-pleated pastry, baked golden
Free-form galette: shortcrust rolled into a rough circle, filled with sliced apples, sugar and cinnamon, edges folded by hand, baked at 200C for 40 minutes.
K: Red wine warmed with orange, cinnamon, star anise, cloves and honey

Pinot noir warmed gently with orange, cinnamon, star anise and a little honey, served steaming in mugs. Pour 750ml pinot noir into a saucepan with 2 strips orange peel, the juice of 1 orange, 1 cinnamon stick, 2 star anise, 4 cloves and 3 tbsp honey. Warm over low heat for 15 minutes without boiling. Strain into 4 mugs and add a thin orange slice to each.

steps.text: Mix the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, sugar and salt in a bowl.
Stir in the buttermilk, egg and sliced spring onions to a thick batter.
Beat the softened butter with the honey until smooth.
Heat the oil to 180C in a deep pan.
Drop in teaspoons of batter and fry until golden, turning once. Drain on paper and serve hot with the honey butter.
Grill the baguette slices until charred at the edges.
Rub each warm toast with the cut garlic clove.
Dice the tomatoes and dress with torn basil, salt and olive oil.
Spoon the tomato onto the toasts just before serving so they stay crisp.
Boil the rigatoni in salted water until just tender, then drain.
Meanwhile, remove the sausage skins, crumble the meat and brown it in a large pan.
Add the sliced fennel and crushed garlic and cook until soft.
Pour in the wine and let it bubble down, then stir in the cream.
Toss the rigatoni through the sauce with the grated parmesan.
Heat the oven to 200C and line a tray with baking paper.
Roll the pastry sheet into a rough circle on the tray.
Toss the sliced apples with the sugar and cinnamon and pile in the middle.
Fold the edges up by hand, pleating as you go.
Bake until golden. Cool a little before slicing.
Pour the wine into a saucepan with the orange peel, the orange juice, cinnamon, star anise, cloves and honey.
Warm over low heat without boiling, so the alcohol stays in.
Strain into mugs and add a thin orange slice to each.

s.note: Crisp cornmeal fritters with spring onion and honey butter.
s.how: Mix 150g cornmeal, 75g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp sugar and 1 tsp salt. Stir in 200ml buttermilk, 1 egg and 3 sliced spring onions. Drop teaspoons into oil at 180C and fry 3 minutes until golden. Serve hot with 60g butter beaten with 2 tbsp honey.

s.note: Garlic-rubbed toasts with ripe tomato and basil
s.how: Grill 16 baguette slices until charred at the edges and rub each with a cut garlic clove. Dice 4 ripe tomatoes and dress with torn basil, salt and 2 tbsp good olive oil. Spoon on just before serving so the toasts stay crisp.

m.note: Rigatoni with sausage, fennel, white wine and cream
m.how: Brown 4 Italian sausages, skins off and crumbled. Add 1 sliced fennel bulb and 2 garlic cloves and cook 8 minutes. Deglaze with 125ml white wine, add 150ml cream, and toss with 500g cooked rigatoni and 60g grated parmesan.

w.note: Rustic hand-folded apple galette with cinnamon sugar
w.how: Roll a sheet of shortcrust pastry into a rough circle. Toss 4 sliced apples with 60g sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon and pile in the middle. Fold the edges up by hand, pleating as you go, and bake at 200C for 40 minutes until golden.

d.note: Pinot noir warmed gently with orange, cinnamon, star anise and a little honey, served steaming in mugs.
d.how: Pour 750ml pinot noir into a saucepan with 2 strips orange peel, the juice of 1 orange, 1 cinnamon stick, 2 star anise, 4 cloves and 3 tbsp honey. Warm over low heat for 15 minutes without boiling. Strain into 4 mugs and add a thin orange slice to each.
